name: Nightingale
description: Evaluates alert rules over metrics, logs, and SQL sources and routes notifications for SRE teams, with a built-in AI agent and an MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Alert Investigation
skills.description: Queries related metrics and logs and inspects affected hosts to explain why an alert fired.

skills.name: Alert Pipeline Troubleshooting
skills.description: Inspects rules, evaluation logs, mutes, event processing, and notification results to find why an alert did not fire or arrive.

skills.name: Configuration by Chat
skills.description: Builds alert rules and dashboards, generates PromQL and SQL, and sets notification rules, mutes, and subscriptions.

skills.name: MCP Toolsets
skills.description: Exposes alerts, metrics, logs, dashboards, and other toolsets at /mcp, read-only by default, under the caller's API permissions.

skills.name: A2A Delegation
skills.description: Lets other agents delegate tasks to Nightingale's built-in agent over the A2A protocol.
